summary: Hobucken lookout in Pamlico County: a new 120-foot steel state tower built 1962-64 on newly acquired land; no source describes what remains at the site today.

events.note: New 120-foot steel tower built on a newly acquired site; the entry gives the span 1962-64 and credits the 20th biennial report (1964)

notes_for_editor: The whole record is one short entry on a hobbyist lookout site (Forest Lookouts), with no page of its own, plus one line in a tower index. There is no height in use, staffing, status or site detail. The word 'new' with 'newly acquired site' may suggest an earlier tower on the site, but no source says so. Two web searches and the Wikipedia article for Hobucken found nothing about the tower. The site's current condition and public access are unknown.
